symbols.name: number of smaller calls
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls that the edges of the network cost.
symbols.quote: The labelling chooses the frames of [Frames on wire arrays](array-frames.md) so that $W$ wires cost $s<Wm$ smaller calls, the saving the recursion needs.

symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires of the network under consideration.
symbols.quote: The labelling chooses the frames of [Frames on wire arrays](array-frames.md) so that $W$ wires cost $s<Wm$ smaller calls, the saving the recursion needs.

symbols.name: a label subspace
symbols.meaning: A subspace of the label space, such as the label of a vertex.
symbols.quote: A subspace $U$ is *nondegenerate* when the form restricted to it is, so the space is $U\perp U^\perp$.

symbols.name: one-factor label space
symbols.meaning: The space $\mathbb Q^h$ with the form $x\cdot y-\frac19(\sum_ix_i)(\sum_iy_i)$ for the bit network, or $\mathbb F_2^h$ with the dot product for the complex network.
symbols.quote: Bit labels live in $F=\mathbb Q^h$, where $h=100$, with the form $\langle x,y\rangle=x\cdot y-\frac19(\sum_ix_i)(\sum_iy_i)$ for vectors $x,y\in F$.

symbols.name: vector of F
symbols.meaning: A vector of $F$, the first argument of the bilinear form.
symbols.quote: Bit labels live in $F=\mathbb Q^h$, where $h=100$, with the form $\langle x,y\rangle=x\cdot y-\frac19(\sum_ix_i)(\sum_iy_i)$ for vectors $x,y\in F$.

symbols.name: vector of F
symbols.meaning: A vector of $F$, the second argument of the bilinear form.
symbols.quote: Bit labels live in $F=\mathbb Q^h$, where $h=100$, with the form $\langle x,y\rangle=x\cdot y-\frac19(\sum_ix_i)(\sum_iy_i)$ for vectors $x,y\in F$.

symbols.name: triple indicator
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector in $F$ of the triple $S$.
symbols.quote: For *triples* (three-element subsets of $[h]$) $S,S'$, indicator vectors $t_S,t_{S'}$ have integer dot product $|S\cap S'|$ and entry sum $3$, so $\langle t_S,t_{S'}\rangle=|S\cap S'|-1$; over $\mathbb F_2$, $t_S\cdot t_{S'}=|S\cap S'|\bmod 2$.

symbols.name: ambient label space
symbols.meaning: The space $F^{\otimes3}$, of dimension $m=h^3$, in which all labels lie.
symbols.quote: Labels are built as [tensor products of subspaces](tensor-product-of-spaces.md) inside $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$, of dimension $m=h^3=10^6$, whose form multiplies factorwise.

symbols.name: X bank
symbols.meaning: The bank of data wires $X_a$.
symbols.quote: Banks $X$ and $Y$ hold data wires $X_a,Y_a$, indexed by the $N=v^3$ tuples $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ of triples ($v=\binom h3=161700$).

symbols.name: Y bank
symbols.meaning: The bank of data wires $Y_a$.
symbols.quote: Banks $X$ and $Y$ hold data wires $X_a,Y_a$, indexed by the $N=v^3$ tuples $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ of triples ($v=\binom h3=161700$).

symbols.name: terminal line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}$, the source label of $X_a$.
symbols.quote: With $U_a=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ the terminal labels are

symbols.name: total dimension loss
symbols.meaning: The total number of dimensions lost on decreasing edges.
symbols.quote: If decreasing edges lose $L$ dimensions, absolute changes total $Wm-2N+2L$, so labels must keep $L$ small.

symbols.name: stage number
symbols.meaning: The stage, 1, 2 or 3, whose invocations act on coordinate $a_j$.
symbols.quote: In one invocation of stage $j$, which acts on coordinate $a_j$, put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: exposed factor space
symbols.meaning: The tensor product $F^{\otimes(j-1)}$ of the factors exposed before stage $j$.
symbols.quote: In one invocation of stage $j$, which acts on coordinate $a_j$, put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: earlier tensor line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}$ inside $A$.
symbols.quote: In one invocation of stage $j$, which acts on coordinate $a_j$, put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: complement of P
symbols.meaning: The orthogonal complement of $P$ inside $A$.
symbols.quote: In one invocation of stage $j$, which acts on coordinate $a_j$, put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: later tensor line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by $t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}$, tensored onto every label of stage $j$.
symbols.quote: In one invocation of stage $j$, which acts on coordinate $a_j$, put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\cap A,\ K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ (empty products are scalars).

symbols.name: next exposed space
symbols.meaning: The next stage's $A$, equal to $A\otimes F$.
symbols.quote: It is the next stage's $B'$, for $A'=A\otimes F$ and $P'=P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle$; with $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ the outputs $A'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ and $B'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ are stage $j+1$'s inputs.

symbols.name: next earlier line
symbols.meaning: The next stage's $P$, equal to $P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle$.
symbols.quote: It is the next stage's $B'$, for $A'=A\otimes F$ and $P'=P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle$; with $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ the outputs $A'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ and $B'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ are stage $j+1$'s inputs.

symbols.name: next complement
symbols.meaning: The next stage's $B$, the orthogonal complement of $P'$ in $A'$.
symbols.quote: It is the next stage's $B'$, for $A'=A\otimes F$ and $P'=P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle$; with $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ the outputs $A'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ and $B'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ are stage $j+1$'s inputs.

symbols.name: next later line
symbols.meaning: The next stage's $K$, with $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$.
symbols.quote: It is the next stage's $B'$, for $A'=A\otimes F$ and $P'=P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle$; with $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ the outputs $A'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ and $B'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ are stage $j+1$'s inputs.

symbols.name: bit dimension loss
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges of the bit network.
symbols.quote: Each of the $I=3v^2$ invocations ($v^2$ per stage) has one such edge per centre wire, so the losses are $L_{\rm b}=Ic_{\rm b}h$ and $L_{\rm c}=Ic_{\rm c}h$, with $c_{\rm b}=100$ (bit) and $c_{\rm c}=101$ (complex) centre wires per invocation

symbols.name: complex dimension loss
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges of the complex network.
symbols.quote: Each of the $I=3v^2$ invocations ($v^2$ per stage) has one such edge per centre wire, so the losses are $L_{\rm b}=Ic_{\rm b}h$ and $L_{\rm c}=Ic_{\rm c}h$, with $c_{\rm b}=100$ (bit) and $c_{\rm c}=101$ (complex) centre wires per invocation

symbols.name: projection onto a label
symbols.meaning: The rational projection onto the label $U$ along $U^\perp$, the matrix of a bit-network vertex labelled $U$.
symbols.quote: A vertex labelled $U$ gets the projection $\Pi_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$, except sources: $-\Pi_{U_a}$ at $X_a$, else $0$.

symbols.name: larger label
symbols.meaning: A label containing the label $U$ at the other end of an edge.
symbols.quote: For $U\subset V$, $\Pi_V-\Pi_U$ (identity on $V\cap U^\perp$, zero on $U\perp V^\perp$) has rank $\dim V-\dim U$, as does its negative.

symbols.name: bit smaller calls
symbols.meaning: The number of smaller calls, the total rational rank of edge matrix differences, in the bit network.
symbols.quote: So $s_{\rm b}=(W_{\rm b}m-2N+2L_{\rm b})+N=W_{\rm b}m-(N-2L_{\rm b})<W_{\rm b}m$

symbols.name: complex smaller calls
symbols.meaning: The number of smaller calls, the total number of phase kernels, in the complex network.
symbols.quote: [Binary phase frames](phase-frames.md) give the complex network $s_{\rm c}=W_{\rm c}m-2N+2L_{\rm c}<W_{\rm c}m$.

Labels are built as [tensor products of subspaces](tensor-product-of-spaces.md) inside $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$, of dimension $m=h^3=10^6$, whose form multiplies factorwise.

derivations.quote: Its matrix fixes zero-sum vectors and scales the all-ones vector by $1-h/9=-91/9\neq0$, so it is nondegenerate. Complex labels live in $F=\mathbb F_2^h$ with the dot product. For *triples* (three-element subsets of $[h]$) $S,S'$, indicator vectors $t_S,t_{S'}$ have integer dot product $|S\cap S'|$ and entry sum $3$, so $\langle t_S,t_{S'}\rangle=|S\cap S'|-1$; over $\mathbb F_2$, $t_S\cdot t_{S'}=|S\cap S'|\bmod 2$. Each line $\langle t_S\rangle$ is thus nondegenerate ($\langle t_S,t_S\rangle\in\{2,1\}$), and *neighbours* (bit: sharing one element; complex: distinct with even intersection) are orthogonal.
Source dimensions total $N$ and sink dimensions $Nm+N(m-1)+(W-2N)m=Wm-N$.
A wire enters and leaves each gate with that gate's label, so its signed changes telescope to sink minus source dimension; over all wires they total $Wm-2N$.

Splitting $A=B\perp P$ and $F=\langle t_{a_j}\rangle\perp t_{a_j}^\perp$ cuts $A\otimes F$ into four orthogonal nondegenerate pieces; the complement of $P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle$ is the other three: $(P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle)^\perp_{A\otimes F}=(B\otimes F)\perp(P\otimes t_{a_j}^\perp)$. It is the next stage's $B'$, for $A'=A\otimes F$ and $P'=P\otimes\langle t_{a_j}\rangle$; with $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ the outputs $A'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ and $B'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K'$ are stage $j+1$'s inputs. Stage $1$ starts at $U_a,0$ ($B=0$) and stage $3$ ends at $\mathcal F,U_a^\perp$.
The same splitting shows every arrow is an inclusion except centre $3\to4$, dropping $P\otimes F$ of dimension $h$; side $2\to5$ needs $\langle t_X\rangle\subset t_Y^\perp$, true as $t_X\perp t_Y$.

Each of the $I=3v^2$ invocations ($v^2$ per stage) has one such edge per centre wire, so the losses are $L_{\rm b}=Ic_{\rm b}h$ and $L_{\rm c}=Ic_{\rm c}h$, with $c_{\rm b}=100$ (bit) and $c_{\rm c}=101$ (complex) centre wires per invocation

A vertex labelled $U$ gets the projection $\Pi_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$, except sources: $-\Pi_{U_a}$ at $X_a$, else $0$. For $U\subset V$, $\Pi_V-\Pi_U$ (identity on $V\cap U^\perp$, zero on $U\perp V^\perp$) has rank $\dim V-\dim U$, as does its negative. Only $X_a$'s first edge differs: at stage $1$ its first gate has label $U_a$, so $2\Pi_{U_a}$ has rank one where the dimension change is zero. Endpoint differences ($\Pi_{U_a^\perp}+\Pi_{U_a}$ from source $X_a$ to sink $Y_a$, else $\mathrm{Id}-0$) all equal $\mathrm{Id}$, giving every role the same shear. So $s_{\rm b}=(W_{\rm b}m-2N+2L_{\rm b})+N=W_{\rm b}m-(N-2L_{\rm b})<W_{\rm b}m$
